SELECT queue_players.player_id AS queue_players_player_id, queue_players.last_claim_at AS queue_players_last_claim_at, queue_players.pending AS queue_players_pending 
FROM queue_players 
WHERE queue_players.player_id = %(pk_1)s::VARCHAR
UPDATE queue_players SET last_claim_at=%(last_claim_at)s::BIGINT WHERE queue_players.player_id = %(queue_players_player_id)s::VARCHAR
UPDATE runs SET status=%(status)s::VARCHAR, attempts=%(attempts)s::INTEGER, lease_until=%(lease_until)s::INTEGER, lease_token=%(lease_token)s::VARCHAR WHERE runs.id = %(runs_id)s::VARCHAR
INSERT INTO object_pins (digest, expires_at) VALUES (%(digest)s::VARCHAR, %(expires_at)s::INTEGER) ON CONFLICT (digest) DO UPDATE SET expires_at = excluded.expires_at

SELECT runs.player_id 
FROM runs 
WHERE runs.id = %(id_1)s::VARCHAR

SELECT players.username_key, players.id, players.display_name, players.country_code, players.needs_username, players.disabled, players.deleted_at, players.analytics_enabled, players.is_test_driver, players.vehicle_appearances, players.created_at 
FROM players 
WHERE players.id = %(id_1)s::VARCHAR FOR NO KEY UPDATE

SELECT runs.id, runs.ticket_id, runs.player_id, runs.board_id, runs.replay_hash, runs.ghost_hash, runs.status, runs.created_at, runs.finished_at, runs.attempts, runs.lease_until, runs.lease_token, runs.time_ticks, runs.lap_ticks, runs.failure_code 
FROM runs 
WHERE runs.id = %(id_1)s::VARCHAR FOR UPDATE

SELECT boards.id, boards.version_id, boards.vehicle_id, boards.manifest, boards.created_at, boards.stats_revision, boards.lap_revision, boards.public_count, boards.all_count, track_versions.id AS id_1, track_versions.track_id, track_versions.number, track_versions.name, track_versions.content_hash, track_versions.redacted_track_hash, track_versions.revision_key, track_versions.manifest AS manifest_1, track_versions.discovery, track_versions.state, track_versions.created_at AS created_at_1, track_versions.published_at, track_versions.creator_test_run_id, track_versions.rating_sum, track_versions.rating_count, track_versions.verified_finishers, tracks.id AS id_2, tracks.owner_id, tracks.authoring_id, tracks.hidden, tracks.archived, tracks.official, tracks.created_at AS created_at_2, rivalry_tickets.ticket_id, rivalry_tickets.group_id, rivalry_tickets.slot, rivalry_tickets.outcome, challenge_tickets.ticket_id AS ticket_id_1, challenge_tickets.challenge_id, challenge_tickets.outcome AS outcome_1, coin_rewards.run_id, coin_rewards.player_id, coin_rewards.amount, coin_rewards.rows, coin_rewards.created_at AS created_at_3, coin_wallets.player_id AS player_id_1, coin_wallets.balance, coin_wallets.revision, personal_bests.time_ticks, lap_personal_bests.time_ticks AS time_ticks_1 
FROM boards JOIN track_versions ON track_versions.id = boards.version_id JOIN tracks ON tracks.id = track_versions.track_id LEFT OUTER JOIN rivalry_tickets ON rivalry_tickets.ticket_id = %(ticket_id_2)s::VARCHAR LEFT OUTER JOIN challenge_tickets ON challenge_tickets.ticket_id = %(ticket_id_3)s::VARCHAR LEFT OUTER JOIN coin_rewards ON coin_rewards.run_id = %(run_id_1)s::VARCHAR LEFT OUTER JOIN coin_wallets ON coin_wallets.player_id = %(player_id_2)s::VARCHAR LEFT OUTER JOIN personal_bests ON personal_bests.board_id = boards.id AND personal_bests.player_id = %(player_id_3)s::VARCHAR LEFT OUTER JOIN lap_personal_bests ON lap_personal_bests.board_id = boards.id AND lap_personal_bests.player_id = %(player_id_4)s::VARCHAR 
WHERE boards.id = %(id_3)s::VARCHAR

UPDATE runs SET status=%(status)s::VARCHAR, finished_at=%(finished_at)s::INTEGER, lease_until=%(lease_until)s::INTEGER, lease_token=%(lease_token)s::VARCHAR, time_ticks=%(time_ticks)s::INTEGER, lap_ticks=%(lap_ticks)s::JSON WHERE runs.id = %(runs_id)s::VARCHAR

INSERT INTO personal_bests (board_id, player_id, run_id, time_ticks, achieved_at) VALUES (%(board_id)s::VARCHAR, %(player_id)s::VARCHAR, %(run_id)s::VARCHAR, %(time_ticks)s::INTEGER, %(achieved_at)s::INTEGER) ON CONFLICT (board_id, player_id) DO UPDATE SET run_id = %(param_1)s::VARCHAR, time_ticks = %(param_2)s::INTEGER, achieved_at = %(param_3)s::INTEGER WHERE personal_bests.time_ticks > %(time_ticks_1)s::INTEGER

SELECT players.username_key, players.id, players.display_name, players.country_code, players.needs_username, players.disabled, players.deleted_at, players.analytics_enabled, players.is_test_driver, players.vehicle_appearances, players.created_at 
FROM players 
WHERE players.id = %(id_1)s::VARCHAR FOR UPDATE

SELECT studio_coin_entries.id AS studio_coin_entries_id, studio_coin_entries.player_id AS studio_coin_entries_player_id, studio_coin_entries.reference AS studio_coin_entries_reference, studio_coin_entries.kind AS studio_coin_entries_kind, studio_coin_entries.amount AS studio_coin_entries_amount, studio_coin_entries.created_at AS studio_coin_entries_created_at, studio_coin_entries.detail AS studio_coin_entries_detail 
FROM studio_coin_entries 
WHERE studio_coin_entries.id = %(pk_1)s::VARCHAR

SELECT coin_milestones.player_id, coin_milestones.scope, coin_milestones.value 
FROM coin_milestones 
WHERE coin_milestones.player_id = %(player_id_1)s::VARCHAR AND coin_milestones.scope IN (%(scope_1_1)s::VARCHAR, %(scope_1_2)s::VARCHAR, %(scope_1_3)s::VARCHAR)

SELECT reward_rank_counts.node, reward_rank_counts.total 
FROM reward_rank_counts 
WHERE reward_rank_counts.board_id = %(board_id_1)s::VARCHAR AND reward_rank_counts.metric = %(metric_1)s::VARCHAR AND reward_rank_counts.node IN (%(node_1_1)s::BIGINT, %(node_1_2)s::BIGINT, %(node_1_3)s::BIGINT, %(node_1_4)s::BIGINT, %(node_1_5)s::BIGINT, %(node_1_6)s::BIGINT, %(node_1_7)s::BIGINT, %(node_1_8)s::BIGINT)

SELECT reward_rank_counts.node, reward_rank_counts.total 
FROM reward_rank_counts 
WHERE reward_rank_counts.board_id = %(board_id_1)s::VARCHAR AND reward_rank_counts.metric = %(metric_1)s::VARCHAR AND reward_rank_counts.node IN (%(node_1_1)s::BIGINT, %(node_1_2)s::BIGINT, %(node_1_3)s::BIGINT, %(node_1_4)s::BIGINT, %(node_1_5)s::BIGINT, %(node_1_6)s::BIGINT, %(node_1_7)s::BIGINT)

INSERT INTO achievement_states (player_id, scope, metrics, unlocked, featured, revision, rarity_pending, rarity_counted) SELECT %(param_1)s::VARCHAR AS anon_1, %(param_2)s::VARCHAR AS anon_2, %(param_3)s::JSON AS anon_3, %(param_4)s::JSON AS anon_4, %(param_5)s::JSON AS anon_5, %(param_6)s::INTEGER AS anon_6, %(param_7)s AS anon_7, %(param_8)s::JSON AS anon_8 
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT players.id 
FROM players 
WHERE players.id = %(id_1)s::VARCHAR AND players.disabled IS false AND players.deleted_at IS NULL AND players.is_test_driver IS false) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

SELECT achievement_states.player_id, achievement_states.scope, achievement_states.metrics, achievement_states.unlocked, achievement_states.featured, achievement_states.revision, achievement_states.rarity_pending, achievement_states.rarity_counted 
FROM achievement_states 
WHERE achievement_states.player_id = %(player_id_1)s::VARCHAR AND achievement_states.scope = %(scope_1)s::VARCHAR FOR UPDATE
INSERT INTO achievement_facts (player_id, kind, identity) VALUES (%(player_id)s::VARCHAR, %(kind)s::VARCHAR, %(identity)s::VARCHAR) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING achievement_facts.identity

UPDATE achievement_states SET metrics=%(metrics)s::JSON, revision=%(revision)s::INTEGER WHERE achievement_states.player_id = %(achievement_states_player_id)s::VARCHAR AND achievement_states.scope = %(achievement_states_scope)s::VARCHAR
UPDATE coin_wallets SET balance=%(balance)s::INTEGER, revision=%(revision)s::INTEGER WHERE coin_wallets.player_id = %(coin_wallets_player_id)s::VARCHAR

SELECT studio_coin_entries.id AS studio_coin_entries_id, studio_coin_entries.player_id AS studio_coin_entries_player_id, studio_coin_entries.reference AS studio_coin_entries_reference, studio_coin_entries.kind AS studio_coin_entries_kind, studio_coin_entries.amount AS studio_coin_entries_amount, studio_coin_entries.created_at AS studio_coin_entries_created_at, studio_coin_entries.detail AS studio_coin_entries_detail 
FROM studio_coin_entries 
WHERE studio_coin_entries.id = %(pk_1)s::VARCHAR

INSERT INTO studio_coin_entries (id, player_id, reference, kind, amount, created_at, detail) VALUES (%(id)s::VARCHAR, %(player_id)s::VARCHAR, %(reference)s::VARCHAR, %(kind)s::VARCHAR, %(amount)s::INTEGER, %(created_at)s::INTEGER, %(detail)s::JSON)
INSERT INTO coin_rewards (run_id, player_id, amount, rows, created_at) VALUES (%(run_id)s::VARCHAR, %(player_id)s::VARCHAR, %(amount)s::INTEGER, %(rows)s::JSON, %(created_at)s::INTEGER)

SELECT %(param_1)s::VARCHAR AS anon_1, personal_bests.time_ticks 
FROM personal_bests 
WHERE personal_bests.board_id = %(board_id_1)s::VARCHAR AND personal_bests.player_id = %(player_id_1)s::VARCHAR AND personal_bests.run_id = %(run_id_1)s::VARCHAR UNION ALL SELECT %(param_2)s::VARCHAR AS anon_2, lap_personal_bests.time_ticks 
FROM lap_personal_bests 
WHERE lap_personal_bests.board_id = %(board_id_2)s::VARCHAR AND lap_personal_bests.player_id = %(player_id_2)s::VARCHAR AND lap_personal_bests.run_id = %(run_id_2)s::VARCHAR
UPDATE track_versions SET state=%(state)s::VARCHAR, creator_test_run_id=%(creator_test_run_id)s::VARCHAR WHERE track_versions.id = %(id_1)s::VARCHAR AND track_versions.state = %(state_1)s::VARCHAR
asserted: Exact native-proof ticks/laps; one reward per race; exact cumulative wallet; no native IO
scope: Warmed worker claim through atomic finalization; isolated schema/local objects; excludes upload/HTTP/cloud IO
